Name: Nyapu-style Portraits for NPC Juna
Author: prerona2411
Description:
I adore Juna. I also adore using Nyapu's portraits. So I thought, 'why not make some Nyapu-style portraits for Juna myself?'
And that's what I did.
Thank you so much to elhrvy for giving me permission to make portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url]! It's an amazing NPC mod so be sure to check it out!
And a big thanks to Nyapu as well, for allowing me to use their gorgeous portraits as reference for my art. Definitely check out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]mod[/url], they've made portraits for a variety of NPCs!

[size=3][b]STEPS!
[/b][/size]- Unzip the mod﻿ and you'll find two folders, EventImages and Portraits.
- Copy these folders over to [NPC] Juna --> [CP] Juna --> assets --> Images
- When given the prompt asking if you want to replace files (specifically 16 files), replace them. 

Mods in preview pictures:
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url], of course! Go get this mod if you want a witty ballerina in your game.
- The gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams[/url] Interface by Vinilla! 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]
